advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Broaden `_SCALAR_PIN_RE` to accept single-quoted (and ideally unquoted) `python-version:` values so single-quoted setup-python pins (reconcile-bridge.yml, reconcile-bridge-canary.yml) are covered by the drift guard.
evidence: tests/unit/test_worktree_python_pin.py:34: `_SCALAR_PIN_RE = re.compile(r'^\s*python-version:\s*"(?P<version>\d+\.\d+)"', re.MULTILINE)` — the pattern requires a double-quote after `python-version:`

Test docstring claims it 'fails if the pin ... disagrees with the actions/setup-python pins' (tests/unit/test_worktree_python_pin.py:9-11), but `_setup_python_pins` (lines 68-77) can never yield the single-quoted pins, so those two workflows could drift to an off-pin version without reddening any test.
advisory.finding: The setup-python drift guard only matches DOUBLE-quoted `python-version:` values, so single-quoted pins in workflows are silently exempt from the anti-drift check the change is built around.
advisory.suggested_fix: Change the regex to allow either quote style, e.g. `r'^\s*python-version:\s*["\']?(?P<version>\d+\.\d+)["\']?\s*$'`, and confirm it still excludes the matrix bracket-list form.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a test that runs `make venv` with no `uv` on PATH and asserts exit != 0 plus the 'uv is required' message.
evidence: `_sandbox` always writes an executable uv stub: tests/unit/test_worktree_python_pin.py:117 `stub_uv = stub_bin / "uv"` and prepends it to PATH at :125
ABSENCE: `search_files` for `command -v uv` in the test file returns (no matches) — no test runs `make venv` with uv missing from PATH
advisory.finding: The `make venv` recipe's uv-absent error branch (Makefile lines 141-144: `command -v uv ... exit 1`) is never exercised by any test. Both `_sandbox` invocations always install a recording `uv` stub on PATH, so the distinct 'uv is required' failure path (its own message and non-zero exit) has zero coverage; a regression removing that guard or its `exit 1` would pass the suite.
scenarios: A refactor that drops the `command -v uv` precheck (letting the recipe fall through to a raw `uv venv` NameError-style shell failure) or changes its exit code would not redden any test.
advisory.suggested_fix: Add a test using a sandbox whose PATH omits the uv stub (e.g. `env['PATH']` set to only a minimal dir), asserting `result.returncode != 0` and `"'uv' is required" in (result.stdout + result.stderr)`.
